stories.title: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Meta is rolling out its new Muse Image model, developed by its Superintelligence Labs division.
The model is integrating AI image generation across Meta's ecosystem, including Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI.
This launch signals a significant expansion of Meta's generative AI capabilities across its core social platforms.

stories.title: Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Hackers are leveraging popular Large Language Models (LLMs) to build large-scale botnets.
The attack vector, dubbed 'HalluSquatting,' exploits the tendency of LLMs to generate confident but incorrect information.
This represents a significant new security vulnerability in widely adopted AI tools.

stories.title: GitLost: We Tricked GitHub's AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
stories.author: ColinEberhardt
bullet_points: A vulnerability was discovered where an attacker tricked GitHub's AI agent.
The exploit allowed unauthorized access and leakage of private repositories.
This highlights critical security risks associated with integrating AI agents into major platforms.

stories.title: Tenda firmware (multiple versions) contains hidden authentication backdoor
stories.author: miniBill
bullet_points: Tenda router firmware has been found to contain hidden authentication backdoors.
This vulnerability affects multiple versions of the Tenda firmware.
The discovery represents a significant security risk in consumer networking hardware.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function.
Key associated technologies include transformers and safetensors, standard in modern LLM deployment.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The model is associated with key technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation and utilizes transformers and safetensors formats.
A corresponding research paper is referenced via the arXiv identifier: arxiv:2606.19348.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.31 achieves significant speed improvements for Gemma 4 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to 90% faster performance according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to faster response times and higher quality model outputs.
The updated engine also demonstrates better memory efficiency when running models.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It integrates native support with Ollama, facilitating local LLM deployment.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for enhanced performance.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon devices, optimizing AI workloads on Apple hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development and optimization.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The core value proposition is running AI agents entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: ollama launch
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama introduces a new command for easily setting up and running coding tools.
It supports various models, including Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex, locally or in the cloud.
A key feature is its simplicity, requiring no environment variables or configuration files.

stories.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: ELSA3D introduces a new framework for unified 3D understanding and generation, aiming to integrate language and 3D data within a single backbone.
It addresses a key limitation in current text-3D models where text and 3D tokens are flattened, losing structural and geometric detail.
The core innovation is 'elastic semantic anchoring,' which structures the language and geometric information separately for better representation.

stories.title: DepthWeave-KV: Token-Adaptive Cross-Layer Residual Factorization for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
stories.author: Jesus Olivera
bullet_points: Addresses the memory bottleneck in long-context language model inference caused by large KV caches.
Introduces DepthWeave-KV, a token-adaptive compression method that avoids uniform budget application across layers/tokens.
Achieves compression by factorizing key and value states across neighboring transformer layers using shared low-rank channel bases.

stories.title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
stories.author: Jesús Olivera
bullet_points: Addresses the critical memory and bandwidth bottleneck of KV caches in long-context LLM inference.
Introduces FreqDepthKV, a novel compression method that factorizes adjacent-layer KV states into shared low-frequency components and sparse high-frequency residuals.
Uses a lightweight online probe to intelligently assign attention heads to shared-depth, residual-depth, or exact cache representations.

stories.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: ELSA3D introduces a new framework to unify 3D understanding and generation within a single foundation model.
It addresses the limitation of existing text-3D models that flatten language and 3D tokens, losing structural and geometric detail.
The core innovation is 'elastic semantic anchoring,' which structures language and geometry separately for better interaction.

stories.title: TILDE: TILt-based Distributional Erasure for Concept Unlearning
stories.author: Yuki Mitsufuji
bullet_points: Introduces TILDE, a new method for concept unlearning specifically designed for text-to-image diffusion models.
Addresses the critical need for unlearning in deployed AI systems due to privacy, copyright, and safety regulations.
Focuses on the dual requirement of effective concept removal while maintaining the model's overall quality and semantic diversity.

stories.title: Data Analysis in the Wild: Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Real-World Data Complexities
stories.author: Wei-Peng Chen
bullet_points: Current LLM benchmarks for data analysis are inadequate for real-world complexity.
The paper introduces DataGovBench, a new benchmark using governmental open data.
DataGovBench tests LLMs on challenges like large multi-tabular datasets and exploratory insight discovery.

stories.title: WordVoice: Explicit and Decoupled Multi-Dimensional Word-Level Control for LLM-Based TTS
stories.author: Xiangmin Xu
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of implicit control in current LLM-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems.
Introduces 'WordVoice' to provide explicit and decoupled multi-dimensional word-level control over TTS generation.
Targets critical use cases like audiobook narration and video dubbing where precise stylistic and temporal control is necessary.

stories.title: The best AI models cite retracted papers, and they cannot know it
stories.author: mikeeus
bullet_points: Frontier AI models are confidently citing retracted scientific papers from their training data.
The models are unable to detect these retractions, even for famous, older instances, and miss recent ones.
The proposed solution to this knowledge gap is implementing a registry lookup mechanism.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across diverse hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Meta’s glasses will turn off the camera if you tamper with the privacy light
stories.author: Victoria Song
bullet_points: Meta is updating its smart glasses to enhance privacy protections.
The glasses will automatically disable the camera if the privacy LED light is tampered with or destroyed.
This feature specifically targets unauthorized modifications by 'modders'.

stories.title: Netflix is about to host videos from BuzzFeed, Condé Nast, and other publishers
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Netflix is expanding its content library to include video from major digital publishers like BuzzFeed and Condé Nast.
The partnership involves both licensed archival content and new, ongoing series from these brands.
This move signals a trend toward streaming platforms integrating diverse, non-traditional media content beyond original productions.

stories.title: Anthropic is launching Claude Cowork on mobile and web
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Anthropic's Claude Cowork AI platform is expanding its accessibility to mobile and web.
Initial rollout is prioritized for Claude Max subscribers, with wider availability planned later.
This marks a shift from the platform's previous restriction to desktop applications only.

stories.title: Doom developer id reportedly cut in half as part of Xbox layoffs
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: id Software, a developer of Doom, has reportedly undergone significant layoffs.
The layoffs are linked to the broader mass layoffs affecting Xbox.
Reports suggest staff cuts equate to around 50% of the workforce, with QA departments notably impacted.

stories.title: Data centers’ energy demand threatens Trump’s “Made in America” plan
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The increasing energy consumption of data centers is creating strain on electricity supplies.
This energy demand is negatively impacting electricity costs, particularly in the Rust Belt.
The rising operational costs threaten the viability of Trump's 'Made in America' manufacturing initiatives.

stories.title: SCOTUS lets Texas enforce app store law that Big Tech calls "censorship regime"
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: The Supreme Court's decision upholds a Texas law related to app store regulations.
Big Tech companies have strongly criticized the law, labeling it a 'censorship regime'.
Legal challenges to the age verification aspect of the law are ongoing.

stories.title: Bethesda, id Software reportedly hit hard by Microsoft layoffs
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: Bethesda and id Software are reportedly experiencing significant layoffs.
Some affected teams have seen reductions of as much as 50%.
Further workforce reductions are anticipated.

stories.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
stories.author: Basarab Matei
bullet_points: Introduces the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a new orchestration framework for oncology.
Addresses limitations in current monolithic deep learning models by decoupling data ingestion, routing, and AI inference.
The LCA is designed to be model-agnostic, aiming for scalable clinical decision support.

stories.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
stories.author: Ananth Muppidi
bullet_points: Introduces RSF-GLLM to tackle the semantic gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (QA).
Addresses the differentiability issue in traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines by decoupling graph reasoning from answer generation.
Utilizes a Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module with a GRU-guided query updater to propagate continuous relevance scores.

stories.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
stories.author: Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
bullet_points: The research addresses a key limitation in Vision-Language Models (VLMs): poor generalization in interactive physical reasoning.
The model, VAORA, tackles two major failure modes: hallucinated reasoning that violates physics and misalignment between reasoning and action.
VAORA introduces a novel reward design incorporating complementary rewards for Visual Alignment and Action Outcome Reasoning.

stories.title: FootsiesGym: A Fighting Game Benchmark for Two-Player Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
stories.author: Wesley N. Kerr
bullet_points: Introduces FootsiesGym, an open-source benchmark environment for two-player, zero-sum, imperfect-information games.
Focuses on isolating complex strategic interactions found in fighting game neutral play, using the minimalist 2D game Footsies.
Provides a vectorized simulator designed for high-throughput training, enhancing accessibility and reproducibility for AI research.

stories.title: Industry Classification of GitHub Repositories Using the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)
stories.author: Alexander Quispe
bullet_points: Addresses a gap in understanding the industrial composition of open-source software by mapping GitHub repositories to the NAICS system.
Introduces NAICS-GH, a new corpus containing 6,588 repositories from the US, EU, and Australia.
Aims to enable empirical research on innovation geography and technology diffusion across economic sectors.

stories.title: Graph Convolutional Attention: A Spectral Perspective on Graph Denoising and Diffusion
stories.author: Alejandro Ribeiro
bullet_points: The paper addresses graph denoising, a core problem in graph learning and diffusion models.
It critically examines the use of attention-based architectures (like graph transformers) for graph denoising.
The research suggests that standard attention is suboptimal under a denoising objective, proposing a spectral perspective.

stories.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
stories.author: Basarab Matei
bullet_points: Introduces the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a new framework for clinical decision support in oncology.
LCA addresses limitations of monolithic AI models by providing a model-agnostic orchestration layer.
The framework aims to decouple data ingestion, clinical routing, and AI inference for scalability.

stories.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
stories.author: Juan S. Santillana
bullet_points: Pitwall is a production system designed to generate natural-language race strategy briefings for Formula 1.
The system addresses the challenge of grounded generation under strict real-time deadlines where the state changes rapidly.
It treats factual faithfulness as an architectural property by decomposing generated sentences into typed factual claims.

stories.title: Assessing the Operational Impact of Poisoning Attacks over Augmented 3D Point Cloud Public Datasets for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
stories.author: Joaquin Garcia-Alfaro
bullet_points: The paper investigates the operational impact of poisoning attacks on 3D point cloud datasets used for autonomous vehicles.
Key concerns include object misclassification and the embedding of latent backdoors in trained models.
The study specifically examines how data augmentation techniques affect the resilience of models against these poisoning attacks.

stories.title: What Images Cannot Say: Language-Guided Olfactory Representation Learning
stories.author: Vicky Kalogeiton
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of linking visual scene data (images) with olfactory data (smell signals).
Introduces SCENT, a multimodal framework designed to bridge the gap between vision and olfaction.
Utilizes language guidance and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a semantic intermediary for representation learning.

stories.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
stories.author: Min Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of building high-performance, native full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs).
Focuses on overcoming severe modality interference, which degrades knowledge and compromises semantic integrity in current SLMs.
Proposes a solution using Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling to achieve seamless integration and semantic coherence.

stories.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
stories.author: Ananth Muppidi
bullet_points: Proposes RSF-GLLM to solve semantic gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (QA).
Addresses the issue of non-differentiability in traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines.
Utilizes a Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module with a GRU-guided query updater to enable continuous graph reasoning.

stories.title: DynaKRAG: A Unified Framework for Learnable Evidence Control in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
stories.author: Dongdong Ge
bullet_points: Introduces DynaKRAG, a unified framework designed for learnable evidence control in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the limitation of existing RAG methods, which use predefined or method-specific pipelines for sequential evidence processing.
Aims to learn a shared state condition to better manage complex, multi-step information retrieval and synthesis.

stories.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
stories.author: Juan S. Santillana
bullet_points: Pitwall is a production system designed to generate faithful, real-time natural-language strategy briefings for live sports (specifically Formula 1).
The system addresses the challenge of grounded generation under strict deadlines where the factual state changes rapidly and no reference text is available during generation.
It treats faithfulness as an architectural property by decomposing every generated sentence into typed factual claims.

stories.title: From Voting to Agent Collaboration: Answer-Type-Aware LLM Pipelines for BioASQ 14b
stories.author: Jaewoo Kang
bullet_points: The research introduces a question-type-specific LLM framework to enhance biomedical question answering (BioASQ 14b Task B).
The core innovation is moving beyond single prompting strategies by tailoring inference procedures based on the question type.
The goal is to improve the robustness and evidence grounding of LLMs when integrating information across multiple scientific documents.

stories.title: OpenBSD through 7.9 has a use-after-free allowing local privilege escalation to root (CVE-2026-57589)
stories.author: nvd.nist.gov via fro
bullet_points: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-57589) has been discovered in OpenBSD versions up to 7.9.
The vulnerability is classified as a use-after-free flaw.
Exploitation allows for local privilege escalation to root access.

stories.title: The AI That Writes Code Can't See Its Own Bugs
stories.author: yimtheppariyapol
bullet_points: Self-correcting AI code generation is imperfect, as demonstrated by the initial model failing to catch its own bugs.
A secondary AI model (Codex) was successfully used to identify and catch real bugs in the primary AI's output.
The article proposes a practical workflow for implementing a second model review on every code difference (diff) before merging.

stories.title: How We Made 163 Mental Models Executable for AI Agents
stories.author: bradju
bullet_points: The article details the process of operationalizing abstract 'mental models' (e.g., first principles, inversion) for AI agents.
163 such mental models have been converted into executable, open-source Agent Skills.
This work bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge (prose in books) and practical, runnable AI logic.
